description: Experiment 3 candidate revision (branch 6.1, rOptimizationFailure): identical to poisson1d-baseline-v1 except lossWeights.bc = 100 (a preregistered 3A level). Written before the 3A/3B results were read; used only if the preregistered revision rule (section 7) selects this level.

network.initialization: torch default (Kaiming uniform) under init seed

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.schedule: exponential decay lr -> finalLr over steps
optimizer.stopping: fixed step count; no early stopping (protocol L4)

sampling.rule: collocationCount pool indices drawn without replacement by the run's sampling seed

seedProtocol.rule: triplet i: init=initBase+i, sample=sampleBase+i, batch=batchBase+i, i in 0..runs-1; registered in seed_ledger.json before the first run

thresholdSources.acceptanceCriteria: AC-1..AC-8 thresholds are the frozen governance/POISSON_1D_V1.0_spec.draft.json values (AC-1 1e-3, AC-2 5e-3, AC-3 1e-4, AC-4 1e-2, AC-5 1e-3, AC-6 5e-3, AC-7 1e-2, AC-8 5e-3 SHOULD); epsilonSpec = AC-1 threshold.
thresholdSources.physics: The protocol compilation section 3 lists analytic-fixture defaults (1e-8 / 1e-10) as the preregistration starting point and says the formal values are frozen before SPEC_LOCKED. For a neural approximation judged at AC-1 1e-3 those defaults are unattainable, so the formal PINN values were frozen here, consistent with the AC scale (PH1 1e-2 ~ 2 x AC-6, PH2 = AC-7, PH4 = AC-2, PH6 = AC-2), before any formal training and before D_claim was sealed.
thresholdSources.signatures: sPdeResidual uses the AC-4 threshold on the dev holdout residual; sBcResidual the AC-3 threshold; sLocalizedError a preregistered bin-ratio; sConservation the PH1 threshold; sSeedSensitive the Constitution 10.1 rules.
